notes:
Lead: VP Product (Ava Moreno). Mid-market SaaS — heavy in-customer support automation. Currently on another provider (OpenAI) with ~18M tokens/mo; evaluating Redwood Hosted -> Dedicated path for cost predictability + VPC.

Key context / asks:
- Primary workload: real-time support-agent + nightly reranking for search. Need <200ms p50 for chat frontend; p95 target <800ms for synchronous flows. Throughput: 30–60 concurrent chat sessions, peaks 120 req/s for embeddings/rerank jobs.
- Cost sensitivity: looking for 25–40% unit cost reduction vs current provider. Also want clearer token breakdown per route.
- Migration: must maintain prompt parity and functional identicality (zero-regressions for top-50 intents). Current provider-specific prompt wrappers and function-calling assumptions to be mapped.
- Security: SOC2 + SSO/SAML mandatory, audit logging + KMS for encryption, EU data residency for EU customers (subset of tenant data).
